prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Stage Layout Desktop Companion Launchpad: Redesigns the final home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring live companion preview and clear launch triggers. (why: Finish stage drops 35.2% of users and support reports show confusion around how to control and display pets on the desktop.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Security Sign-In Placement: Moves sign_in after adoption_certificate screen so users build their companion fully before binding their account. (why: Sign_in loses 23.6% of users upfront; placing account registration right after certificate creation increases motivation to save progress.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Habitat Generation Progress Timer: Adds a detailed visual progress bar and real-time generation status messages on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a huge mean duration of 2336s (~39 minutes), leading to user dropoff before final launch.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning Hint: Displays an explicit hint during sign-in reassuring users that signing in preserves custom pet data across sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Copy: Updates home_intro copy to explain tray icon shortcuts and desktop visibility controls clearly. (why: Support received 3 emails about unclear pet controls and 3 emails about pets not appearing on screen.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Completion Background Notification: Enables desktop system notifications when background pet generation completes. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s; background notifications allow users to safely minimize the app without abandoning onboarding.)
6: [adoption, layout] Carousel Layout Companion Picker: Switches the pick_friend screen layout to a dynamic card carousel showcasing animated companion models. (why: Adoption stage experiences high friction (35.1% drop rate); a clear carousel layout improves browsing and decision making.)
